A qualified human must validate the report and explicitly approve any PR emission.

boardItems.summary: Review App token scope, release-please event behavior, and Release PR governance.
boardItems.preliminarySignal: The Release PR must be created by a narrowly scoped App identity while preserving normal CI and branch governance.

boardItems.area: Tag, draft, and immutable publication lifecycle
boardItems.summary: Review partial state, retries, ancestry, and irreversible publication.
boardItems.preliminarySignal: Multiple jobs coordinate protected tag provenance, draft convergence, reruns, asset mutation, and the irreversible publish point.

boardItems.area: Official SPDX environment and supply-chain boundary
boardItems.summary: Review the validator lock, action pins, Syft generation, and cross-job artifact trust.
boardItems.preliminarySignal: Release validity depends on a 13-artifact PyPI lock, SHA-pinned actions, Syft output, and a strict read-only-to-write artifact boundary.

boardItems.summary: Review official-versus-repository ownership and exact root/dependency topology.
boardItems.preliminarySignal: Official tooling and repository policy intentionally split ownership; gaps or duplication can produce false acceptance or brittle maintenance.

boardItems.summary: Review whether exact structural checks and mutations prove all critical fail-closed paths.
boardItems.preliminarySignal: Exact workflow contracts can miss semantic bypasses or overconstrain safe maintenance if mutations do not fail for the intended reason.

boardItems.summary: Review current docs, PR claims, live checks, and first-release acceptance boundaries.
boardItems.preliminarySignal: The PR includes extensive tracking and prior review artifacts alongside current docs and a green live check set.
